temperature_omitted: Claude Haiku 5.5 rejects a non-default temperature with a 400 (claude-api skill, shared/model-migration.md, "Migrating to Claude Haiku 5.5", read 2026-10-14); omitted, it samples at the API default, 1.0
thinking_disabled: Claude Haiku 5.5 runs adaptive thinking by default (effort medium), and thinking tokens count against max_tokens, so a default call would spend the judge's 300-token allowance thinking before it answers; thinking {"type": "disabled"} is accepted at the default effort (a 400 only at effort xhigh or max), and with it neither judge thinks, as Claude Haiku 4.5's judge calls never did; on the Petri lane the two still differ in temperature (Haiku 4.5 was sent 0.0, Haiku 5.5 samples at the API default), so they differ by model alone only on the advice lane (claude-api skill, shared/model-migration.md, "Migrating to Claude Haiku 5.5", read 2026-10-14)
